title: SessionArtifactResource

session_id.description: The ID of the session that owns the artifact.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment that produced the artifact.

turn_id.description: The ID of the completed turn that published the artifact.

path.description: The original absolute file path in the execution environment.

size_bytes.description: The immutable artifact size in bytes.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the artifact was published.

description: An immutable file published by a completed hosted session turn.
